ddl.where: "revoked_at" is null and "team_id" is not null
ddl.name: role_binding_active_team_uidx

ddl.value: char_length("issuer") between 1 and 2048 and char_length("subject") between 1 and 255
ddl.name: account_identity_check

ddl.value:
("actor_kind" = 'user' and "actor_user_id" is not null)
        or ("actor_kind" = 'system' and "actor_user_id" is null)
ddl.name: event_actor_attribution_check

ddl.value: ("intent" = 'accept_invitation' and "invitation_id" is not null and "invitation_revision" > 0 and "target_organization_id" is not null and "display_name" is not null) or ("intent" <> 'accept_invitation' and "invitation_id" is null and "invitation_revision" is null)
ddl.name: auth_flow_invitation_check

ddl.value: ("provider" = 'google' and "connection_organization_id" is null and ("target_organization_id" is null or "intent" = 'accept_invitation')) or ("provider" in ('oidc','saml') and "target_organization_id" is not null and "connection_organization_id" = "target_organization_id")
ddl.name: auth_flow_owner_check

ddl.value: ("provider" = 'saml' and "saml_request_id" is not null and "nonce_hash" is null and "pkce_verifier_ciphertext" is null) or ("provider" in ('google','oidc') and "saml_request_id" is null and "nonce_hash" is not null)
ddl.name: auth_flow_protocol_check

ddl.value: "verified_identity_ciphertext" is null or ("claimed_at" is not null and "consumed_at" is null and "revoked_at" is null)
ddl.name: auth_flow_saml_verified_check

ddl.value: ("intent" = 'sign_in' and "initiating_session_id" is null and "expected_user_id" is null) or ("intent" = 'accept_invitation' and (("initiating_session_id" is null and "expected_user_id" is null) or ("initiating_session_id" is not null and "expected_user_id" is not null))) or ("intent" in ('link','reauthenticate','test') and "initiating_session_id" is not null and "expected_user_id" is not null)
ddl.name: auth_flow_intent_check

ddl.value: "connection_revision" > 0 and "expires_at" > "created_at" and not ("consumed_at" is not null and "revoked_at" is not null) and ("consumed_at" is null or "claimed_at" is not null) and (("consumed_at" is null and "revoked_at" is null) or "pkce_verifier_ciphertext" is null)
ddl.name: auth_flow_lifecycle_check

ddl.value:
("status" = 'processing' and "lease_token" is not null and "lease_expires_at" is not null)
    or ("status" <> 'processing' and "lease_token" is null and "lease_expires_at" is null)
ddl.name: email_lease_check

ddl.value:
("status" in ('pending', 'processing') and "encrypted_payload" is not null)
    or ("status" in ('sent', 'failed', 'expired', 'cancelled') and "encrypted_payload" is null)
ddl.name: email_payload_check

ddl.value: ("provider" = 'google' and "installation_id" is not null and "installation_id" = 1 and "organization_id" is null) or ("provider" in ('oidc','saml') and "installation_id" is null and "organization_id" is not null)
ddl.name: identity_connection_provider_check

ddl.value: "status" in ('draft','tested','active','disabled') and "revision" > 0 and ("tested_revision" is null or "tested_revision" = "revision") and ("status" not in ('active','tested') or ("tested_revision" is not null and "tested_revision" = "revision" and "tested_at" is not null))
ddl.name: identity_connection_status_check

ddl.value:
("bootstrap_token_hash" is null and "bootstrap_token_issued_at" is null and "bootstrap_token_expires_at" is null)
    or ("bootstrap_token_hash" is not null and "bootstrap_token_hash" <> ''
      and "bootstrap_token_issued_at" is not null and "bootstrap_token_expires_at" is not null)
ddl.name: installation_token_fields_check

ddl.value:
("grant_source" = 'owner' and "granted_by_user_id" is not null)
    or ("grant_source" in ('bootstrap', 'operator_recovery') and "granted_by_user_id" is null)
ddl.name: owner_grant_actor_check

ddl.value:
"revoked_at" is not null
    or ("revoked_by_user_id" is null and "revocation_reason" is null)
ddl.name: owner_revocation_metadata_check

ddl.value: ("scope_kind" = 'organization' and "team_id" is null) or ("scope_kind" = 'team' and "team_id" is not null)
ddl.name: invitation_assignment_scope_check

ddl.value: jsonb_typeof("metadata") = 'object' and "metadata" @> '{"version":1}'::jsonb and jsonb_typeof("metadata"->'name') = 'string' and coalesce(char_length("metadata"->>'name') between 1 and 120, false)
ddl.name: organization_metadata_check

ddl.value: not ("consumed_at" is not null and "revoked_at" is not null) and ("consumed_at" is null or "consumed_at" >= "created_at") and ("revoked_at" is null or "revoked_at" >= "created_at")
ddl.name: auth_recovery_token_lifecycle_check

ddl.value: ("verified_at" is null and "verified_until" is null and "verification_method" is null) or ("verified_at" is not null and "verified_until" > "verified_at" and "verification_method" in ('dns','operator'))
ddl.name: domain_verification_check

ddl.value: ("verification_method" = 'operator' and "approved_by_user_id" is not null) or ("verification_method" is distinct from 'operator' and "approved_by_user_id" is null)
ddl.name: domain_operator_check

ddl.value: ("accepted_at" is null) = ("accepted_by_user_id" is null) and not ("accepted_at" is not null and "revoked_at" is not null) and ("accepted_at" is null or "accepted_at" >= "created_at") and ("revoked_at" is null or "revoked_at" >= "created_at")
ddl.name: invitation_lifecycle_check

ddl.value: ("suspended_at" is null or "suspended_at" >= "joined_at") and ("removed_at" is null or "removed_at" >= "joined_at") and ("removed_at" is null or "suspended_at" is null)
ddl.name: member_lifecycle_check

ddl.value: ("kind" = 'builtin' and "key" in ('owner', 'admin', 'member') and "archived_at" is null and ("key" <> 'owner' or "scope_kind" = 'organization')) or ("kind" = 'custom' and "key" not in ('owner', 'admin', 'member'))
ddl.name: role_kind_key_check

ddl.value: ("scope_kind" = 'organization' and "team_id" is null) or ("scope_kind" = 'team' and "team_id" is not null)
ddl.name: role_binding_scope_check

ddl.value: ("method" in ('bootstrap_email_code', 'email_code', 'email_link') and "user_email_id" is not null and "account_id" is null and "connection_revision" is null) or ("method" in ('google','oidc','saml') and "user_email_id" is null and "account_id" is not null and "connection_revision" is not null and "connection_revision" > 0)
ddl.name: session_authentication_method_check

ddl.value: jsonb_typeof("metadata") = 'object' and "metadata" @> '{"version":1}'::jsonb and jsonb_typeof("metadata"->'name') = 'string' and coalesce(char_length("metadata"->>'name') between 1 and 120, false)
ddl.name: team_metadata_check

ddl.value: jsonb_typeof("metadata") = 'object' and "metadata" @> '{"version":1}'::jsonb and jsonb_typeof("metadata"->'name') = 'string' and coalesce(char_length("metadata"->>'name') between 1 and 120, false)
ddl.name: user_metadata_check

ddl.value: not ("consumed_at" is not null and "revoked_at" is not null)
ddl.name: verification_terminal_check

ddl.value: ("consumed_at" is null or "consumed_at" >= "created_at") and ("revoked_at" is null or "revoked_at" >= "created_at")
ddl.name: verification_terminal_time_check

ddl.value: ("purpose" = 'email_sign_in' and (("user_id" is null and "user_email_id" is null and "email_job_id" is null) or ("user_id" is not null and "user_email_id" is not null and "email_job_id" is not null))) or ("purpose" = 'email_reauthentication' and "user_id" is not null and "user_email_id" is not null and "email_job_id" is not null) or ("purpose" in ('invitation_email', 'external_identity_email') and "user_id" is null and "user_email_id" is null and "email_job_id" is not null)
ddl.name: verification_source_check

ddl.value: ("purpose" = 'email_sign_in' and "context" = '{"version":1}'::jsonb) or ("purpose" = 'email_reauthentication' and jsonb_typeof("context") = 'object' and "context"->>'version' = '1' and "context"->>'sessionId' ~ '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$') or ("purpose" = 'external_identity_email' and jsonb_typeof("context") = 'object' and "context"->>'version' = '1' and "context"->>'flowId' ~ '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$' and jsonb_typeof("context"->'email') = 'string') or ("purpose" = 'invitation_email' and jsonb_typeof("context") = 'object' and "context"->>'version' = '1' and "context"->>'invitationId' ~ '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$')
ddl.name: verification_context_check
